switch.title: Switch space
switch.text: Jump from Shop to Training or System in one click.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.text: The key figures of your activity.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: A summary view to compare with the previous period.

orders.title: Orders
orders.text: Confirm payments and move deliveries forward. The orange badge shows orders to process.

products.title: Products
products.text: Create and edit your products, photos and prices. Publish or hide them.

stock.title: Stock
stock.text: Track levels, restock and review the history of movements.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.text: Find and download invoices for paid orders.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Pickup and delivery fees, low-stock threshold and messages to customers.

live.title: Live
live.text: Start a live session, share the link, admit participants and invite guests.

sessions.title: Scheduled sessions
sessions.text: Plan your live sessions in advance.

enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.text: Enroll students in a course and follow their progress.

users.title: Users
users.text: Browse accounts and manage their access.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.text: Every sensitive action is recorded under your name: handy to know who did what.

account.title: Your session
account.text: Your address, the 'Guide for this page' button to replay this guide, and log out. Log out on a shared device.

welcome.title: Welcome to UNIX
welcome.text: A quick guide to this page. Every page has its own: it shows on your first visit and you can replay it with the '?' button.

hero.title: Your shop
hero.text: Kits, templates and guides to launch your business. Tap 'Browse the shop' to see everything.

trust.title: Shop with confidence
trust.text: Secure payment, delivery or pickup, and real people to help on WhatsApp.

new.title: What's new
new.text: The latest products show up here. Tap the + on a card to add it to your cart in one go.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.text: Items you add appear here with their count. You can change quantities before ordering.

whatsapp.title: A question?
whatsapp.text: Message us on WhatsApp. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

track.title: Track without an account
track.text: With the CMD-XXXX-XXXX reference from your email and the order email address, track your parcel without creating an account.

help.title: One guide per page
help.text: This button replays the guide of the page you are on. It is also in the Language/Currency menu.

search.title: Find it fast
search.text: Type a product name: results update as you type.

filters.title: Sort and filter
filters.text: Sort by newest or price, keep only in-stock or recent products, and set a min/max budget just below.

card.title: A product card
card.text: Tap the card to see photos and the description. The button at the bottom adds the item to your cart.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.text: Find what you added here, then place your order.

intro.title: Product page
intro.text: Photos, price, availability and description: everything to decide before adding to cart.

gallery.title: Several photos
gallery.text: Tap a thumbnail to change the displayed image. Tap the image to enlarge it.

buy.title: Add to cart
buy.text: Choose the quantity, add to cart, or ask your question on WhatsApp. If the product is sold out, you can ask to be notified.

desc.title: Description
desc.text: The product details. Further down, find suggestions and recently viewed products.

list.title: Your items
list.text: The content of your cart, with photo and price. Tap the name to go back to the product page.

qty.title: Quantity
qty.text: Use − and + to adjust. The total updates right away.

remove.title: Remove an item
remove.text: The bin removes the item. You have a few seconds to undo.

summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Subtotal and total. Delivery fees are calculated at the next step.

checkout.title: Place the order
checkout.text: Next step: your details, delivery or pickup, then payment.

clear.title: Empty the cart
clear.text: Removes all items at once, after confirmation.

intro.title: Your orders
intro.text: All your orders in one place. Open one to follow its delivery, download the invoice once paid, or write to us.

intro.title: Order details
intro.text: Progress (payment, preparation, shipping, delivery), items and total. A question? Message us on WhatsApp from this page.

intro.title: Your account
intro.text: Three tabs: Profile (your details), Addresses (to pre-fill your orders) and Security (change your password).

ref.title: Your reference
ref.text: Enter the reference from your email, like CMD-XXXX-XXXX. It formats itself.

paste.title: Paste in one tap
paste.text: Copy the reference from the email, then tap 'Paste'.

email.title: Order email
email.text: The address used when ordering. It protects the tracking: no account needed.

welcome.title: Your learning space
welcome.text: Your courses, live sessions and certificates in one place. Every page has its own guide, replayable with the '?' button.

stats.title: Your progress
stats.text: Courses followed, in progress, completed and certificates earned, at a glance.

resume.title: Pick up where you left off
resume.text: Your latest started course is offered here. Your progress is saved automatically.

live.title: A live session is on
live.text: When a live session starts, a red banner appears here. Tap it to join.

catalog.title: The catalog
catalog.text: Browse the available courses and request access.

meetings.title: Your meetings
meetings.text: The meetings and scheduled sessions you are invited to.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Live reminders, invitations and news. The red badge shows unread messages.

help.title: One guide per page
help.text: This button replays the guide of the page you are on.

intro.title: The catalog
intro.text: All the courses on offer. Access is activated by our team after sign-up.

list.title: The courses
list.text: 'Open course' appears once you are enrolled. Otherwise 'Request access' opens WhatsApp with the message ready.

intro.title: Your meetings
intro.text: The meetings and scheduled sessions you are invited to. Join them from this page when they start.

intro.title: Notifications
intro.text: Live reminders, invitations and news. Unread messages are flagged by the red badge in the menu.

welcome.title: Shop space
welcome.text: The essentials to manage products, stock and orders. Every page has its own guide, replayable with the '?' button or 'Guide for this page'.

kpi.title: Key figures
kpi.text: Each card compares the chosen period with the previous one: ▲ up, ▼ down.

card.title: Analytics
card.text: Charts and rankings for the period: sales, statuses, deliveries, best-selling products.

intro.title: Overview
intro.text: A summary view of activity, compared with the previous period, exportable as PDF.

intro.title: Orders
intro.text: Filter with the chips (To process, Today, Stock conflicts...), open 'Details' to see the order, confirm a manual payment and move delivery forward step by step. Sensitive actions are logged under your name.

intro.title: Products
intro.text: Create or edit a product: FR/EN names and descriptions, price, stock, photos. 'Published' makes it visible in the shop, 'Draft' hides it.

intro.title: Stock
intro.text: Filter (low, out, reserved, unpublished), adjust a stock with a reason (restock, damage, inventory...) and review the history: every movement is traced.

intro.title: Invoices
intro.text: Invoices for paid orders: find them and download them.

fees.title: Fees and stock threshold
fees.text: Pickup and delivery fees (Dakar, regions) and the low-stock threshold. Remember to save.

welcome.title: Training space
welcome.text: Manage your courses, live sessions, scheduled sessions and enrollments. Every page has its own guide, replayable with the '?' button.

intro.title: Courses
intro.text: Your course catalog: create, edit and organize what your students see.

course.title: Choose the course
course.text: Select the course for which you start or manage a live session.

controls.title: Start / stop
controls.text: The badge shows whether the live is on. 'Start' opens the room, 'Stop' closes it after confirmation.

share.title: Link to share
share.text: Copy or share the live link with your students.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.text: The meeting information linked to this course.

admission.title: Admission
admission.text: Handle requests to enter the live: admit or refuse participants.

invite.title: Guests
invite.text: Invite people without an account with a personal access link.

intro.title: Scheduled sessions
intro.text: Plan your live sessions in advance so your students get notified.

intro.title: Enrollments
intro.text: Enroll students in a course and follow their progress.

intro.title: Users
intro.text: The platform's accounts: browse them and manage their access (student, blocking...).

intro.title: Activity log
intro.text: Every sensitive action is recorded there with its author: handy to know who did what, and when.
